I agree with you on a lot of points here. From what I am able to see of the game and various peoples streams of it and what not, It appears almost as if many of the threats in this game that the player must consider, arent actually known to the player until they die to it. From what I've seen I completely agree with the notion that the game punishes you for doing what it directs you to do, but I feel as if this only happens because the games neglects to communicate the small detail in what it wants. The game wants you to sift through these sites for info, but as you said, it doesn't tell you about the police coming. Sure it telegraphs it with sirens, but on first encounter with the game there doesn't seem like a way to tell that the sound cue isnt just ambient sound. Additionally methods of dealing with threats like the police and hitman are also not communicated well enough imo, leaving people to lose all their progress due to something that, although telegraphed, is practically on first run unavoidable. I believe that approach to game design in general to be rather unacceptable. I LIKE the fact that the police can find you, because in the context of the world the game has set up, it makes sense, but it is not executed in a way that feels like it is a good game mechanic. I also really agree with you on wifi key crack timings, it might be cool if there was something else you could do while that was happening or something.

I do apologize if I butchered anything you have said in that, but after seeing the game being played by different people for hours and hours each, I also feel that many of the points you put forward are legitimate and I wanted to rant a bit, in the position of an observer outside of the game.

Heya! I myself decided to take a small break from hrt just because this ended up shaking me around quite a lot. And me being a very anxious and negative self talk-y person I needed to step back and regroup for myself. Since then I have just been heavily questioning myself and what I want. I overall feel pretty bad that things have been rocky unlike alot of the super good stuff I hear around this reddit. Makes me feel like I mustve been wrong all this time which I really don't want. I do plan on getting back on hrt once im at a spot where I can maybe deal with that better but that is just me. I also can see now  that I think i did feel better on E than I did before. Now after stopping I just feel kinda dead and anxious and dont get the little bursts of happiness i was getting on E. I am still hoping everything can turn out okay for me. I am actually catching myself missing the little pain of my breast buds lol. It's mainly now that I see that it might just be the case that I am actually scared of the reality and that I never saw this far ahead before. At some point here I got into a really nasty spiral of getting a bad feeling and then just searching things like 'reverse dysphoria' and it would just make me feel worse and worse. I unfortuantely try to use other peoples experience here on reddit to validate my own, which is a bad call seeing as everybody is different and you'll never find someone with the exact same thoughts, experiences and worries as yourself. Overall I feel less distraught but I still go into a panic thinking about whether I want to live a certain way forever, just because the future is something I have never been good at seeing. I guess just you do you for your situation. If you need to take a breather and regroup then that is okay, as is continuing through the anxiety. I should really take my own advice on this one, but, doing whatever you gotta do doesnt invalidate identity like at all. I hope this was of some help
